description:
Workbook on Github -- https://github.com/SiliconDojo/In-Person-Classes/tree/main/Introduction%20to%20Programming%20for%20AI%20


Support Content at - https://donorbox.org/etcg
LinkedIn at - https://www.linkedin.com/in/eli-etherton-a15362211/

This class is going to teach you the basic concepts you have to understand in order to start writing code for your AI projects. We will go over basic concepts like how to pick a programming language, using IDE's, building wireframes, writing pseudocode and more.

Beyond that we will then learn about using LLM's and other AI frameworks and how to actually use these in your projects. And then discuss things such as RAG, MCP and what AI Agents really are.

This class will go over:

How to pick a Programming Language
What are Frameworks
Planning and Designing Projects
Using IDE's to write code
What LLM's and AI Frameworks are
Understanding Systems Architecture for AI Projects
Basic Concepts in Waterfall vs Agile Project Management
Understanding what
title: Introduction to Programming for AI
